lessons.title: Health & Medical
lessons.description: Vocabulary for workplace wellness, medical appointments, and health services.
lessons.tip: Listen for symptoms, treatment, and appointment details in medical and workplace announcements.

words.meaning: a routine medical examination to assess a person?s health
words.example: The clinic offers a free checkup to employees once a year.

words.meaning: a medical facility for outpatient care
words.example: Employees can visit the clinic during the lunch break.

words.meaning: a qualified doctor
words.example: A physician will review the results before calling the patient.

words.meaning: a person receiving medical care
words.example: The patient should arrive fifteen minutes before the examination.

words.meaning: a sign of an illness or condition
words.example: Fatigue was the first symptom reported by several staff members.

words.meaning: identification of an illness or condition
words.example: The doctor gave her a diagnosis after checking the test results.

words.meaning: medical care given for an illness or injury
words.example: The new treatment helped him return to work sooner.

words.meaning: a doctor's written instruction for medicine
words.example: Please take the prescription to the pharmacy downstairs.

words.meaning: a place where medicines are prepared and sold
words.example: The pharmacy closes at six, so collect the medicine before then.

words.meaning: a substance used to treat or prevent illness
words.example: Keep the medicine in its original container.

words.meaning: related to health care or medicine
words.example: The company updated its medical insurance plan this year.

words.meaning: an arrangement that covers specified health costs
words.example: Her insurance covers annual eye examinations.

words.meaning: the protection or services included in an insurance plan
words.example: Check whether the plan provides coverage for physical therapy.

words.meaning: a formal request for payment under an insurance policy
words.example: Submit the claim form with your itemized medical bill.

words.meaning: the state of being healthy and well
words.example: The firm introduced a wellness program for all employees.

words.meaning: the condition of a person's body or mind
words.example: Good health can improve concentration at work.

words.meaning: in good physical or mental condition
words.example: A healthy lunch is available in the staff cafeteria.

words.meaning: physical activity done to improve fitness
words.example: The wellness coach recommends regular exercise during the week.

words.meaning: treatment intended to improve a health condition
words.example: She scheduled therapy sessions after her shoulder injury.

words.meaning: a professional who provides a type of therapy
words.example: The therapist showed him exercises for his back.

words.meaning: physical harm to the body
words.example: The employee reported a minor injury to the safety officer.

words.meaning: a sudden serious situation requiring immediate action
words.example: Call the emergency number if a visitor feels faint.

words.meaning: requiring prompt attention
words.example: The nurse marked the referral as urgent.

words.meaning: to become well again after illness or injury
words.example: He expects to recover fully before the business trip.

words.meaning: the process of becoming well again
words.example: A short break supported her recovery after surgery.

words.meaning: intended to stop illness or problems before they occur
words.example: Preventive care is included in the employee health plan.

words.meaning: a detailed medical inspection
words.example: The annual examination takes about thirty minutes.

words.meaning: a harmful or uncomfortable reaction to a substance
words.example: Please note any food allergy on the conference registration form.

words.meaning: able to spread from one person to another
words.example: Staff with a contagious illness should work from home.

words.meaning: completely free from harmful microorganisms
words.example: Store the sterile equipment in the sealed cabinet.

lessons.title: Education & Training
lessons.description: Terms for courses, professional development, instruction, and assessment.
lessons.tip: Pay attention to course dates, prerequisites, enrollment instructions, and assessment deadlines.

words.meaning: a series of lessons on a subject
words.example: The finance course begins next Monday in the training room.

words.meaning: the process of learning skills for a job or activity
words.example: New-hire training includes a session on data security.

words.meaning: a person learning how to do a job
words.example: Each trainee will shadow an experienced technician.

words.meaning: a person who teaches a skill or subject
words.example: The instructor distributed the safety handbook before class.

words.meaning: an educational talk given to a group
words.example: The guest lecture on customer service starts at noon.

words.meaning: a meeting for discussion or instruction
words.example: She registered for a seminar on project planning.

words.meaning: a practical class where people learn by doing
words.example: The workshop gives managers practice handling difficult calls.

words.meaning: the subjects and content included in a course
words.example: The revised curriculum adds a module on workplace communication.

words.meaning: a document outlining a course and its requirements
words.example: The syllabus lists the readings and assessment dates.

words.meaning: a large room used for teaching groups
words.example: The orientation will take place in lecture hall B.

words.meaning: a room where lessons are taught
words.example: Please return the classroom key to the reception desk.

words.meaning: to officially register for a course or program
words.example: Employees can enroll in the language course through the portal.

words.meaning: the act or process of registering for a course
words.example: Enrollment closes when the class reaches twenty participants.

words.meaning: to be present at an event or class
words.example: All supervisors must attend the compliance training.

words.meaning: the act or record of being present
words.example: The instructor records attendance at the start of each session.

words.meaning: an official document proving a qualification or completion
words.example: She received a certificate after completing the accounting course.

words.meaning: a document or qualification that proves a person?s training or ability

words.example: Please attach a copy of your teaching credential to the application.

words.meaning: having the skills or credentials needed
words.example: Only qualified staff may operate the testing equipment.

words.meaning: an evaluation of ability, performance, or knowledge
words.example: The final assessment includes a short written report.

words.meaning: to evaluate ability, quality, or performance
words.example: Managers assess each participant's progress after the course.

words.meaning: a task given as part of a course or job
words.example: Please upload your assignment before the Friday deadline.

words.meaning: related to education or scholarly study
words.example: Her academic background includes business administration.

words.meaning: financial assistance for a student's education
words.example: The foundation offers a scholarship to local college students.

words.meaning: the fee charged for instruction
words.example: The company reimburses tuition for approved courses.

words.meaning: an experienced person who advises and guides another
words.example: A senior analyst will mentor the new team member.

words.meaning: guidance provided by an experienced person
words.example: The mentoring program pairs graduates with department leaders.

words.meaning: a natural ability to learn or do a particular kind of work
words.vietnameseMeaning: n?ng khi?u, kh? n?ng thi?n b?m
words.example: Her aptitude for languages made her a strong candidate for the translation course.

words.meaning: the ability to do something effectively
words.example: The practical test measures competence with the new software.

words.meaning: specialized knowledge or skill
words.example: Her expertise in logistics helped improve delivery times.

words.meaning: a high level of skill or ability
words.example: Applicants should indicate their proficiency in spreadsheet software.

lessons.title: Environment & Weather
lessons.description: Words for weather conditions, environmental impact, and sustainable operations.
lessons.tip: Distinguish weather forecasts from longer-term climate and environmental reports.

words.meaning: the condition of the atmosphere at a particular time
words.example: Severe weather may delay the delivery scheduled for this afternoon.

words.meaning: a report predicting future weather or conditions
words.example: The forecast calls for heavy rain during the outdoor event.

words.meaning: the usual weather conditions of a region over time
words.example: The report compares the region's climate over several decades.

words.meaning: the degree of heat or cold
words.example: Please keep the storage room at the recommended temperature.

words.meaning: the amount of water vapor in the air
words.example: High humidity can affect the paper stored in the archive.

words.meaning: water that falls from the sky as rain, snow, or hail
words.example: Annual precipitation has increased in the northern district.

words.meaning: a period of violent weather with wind, rain, or snow
words.example: The storm forced the airport to cancel several flights.

words.meaning: an overflow of water onto normally dry land
words.example: Flood damage closed the warehouse for two days.

words.meaning: a long period with little or no rain
words.example: The drought reduced water supplies for local farms.

words.meaning: moving air, especially when strong
words.example: Strong wind made it unsafe to use the rooftop equipment.

words.meaning: covered with or characterized by clouds
words.example: It will be cloudy when the visiting team arrives.

words.meaning: happening once every year
words.example: The company publishes an annual environmental report.

words.meaning: the natural world and the conditions around it
words.example: The factory is reviewing its impact on the local environment.

words.meaning: relating to the natural world and its protection
words.example: Environmental standards apply to every production site.

words.meaning: harmful substances introduced into the air, water, or land
words.example: The city is monitoring air pollution near the highway.

words.meaning: a substance that causes pollution
words.example: The filter removes pollutants before water leaves the plant.

words.meaning: a substance released into the air, especially by an activity
words.example: The new fleet policy aims to lower vehicle emissions.

words.meaning: a chemical element found in all living things and fuels
words.example: The presentation explains how carbon is measured in the supply chain.

words.meaning: replaced naturally and not used up permanently
words.example: The office now purchases electricity from renewable sources.

words.meaning: relating to energy from the sun
words.example: Solar panels provide power to the visitor center.

words.meaning: the protection and careful use of natural resources
words.example: Water conservation is part of the hotel's operating policy.

words.meaning: to use something carefully and avoid waste
words.example: The maintenance team conserves water by repairing leaks promptly.

words.meaning: to process used materials so they can be used again
words.example: Please recycle cardboard in the marked collection area.

words.meaning: the process of making used materials usable again
words.example: Recycling reduces the amount of waste sent to the landfill.

words.meaning: able to continue without exhausting resources or causing severe harm
words.example: The purchasing team is seeking sustainable packaging options.

words.meaning: the practice of maintaining resources for the future
words.example: Sustainability is now included in the supplier review.

words.meaning: material that is unwanted or discarded
words.example: The audit identified ways to reduce packaging waste.

words.meaning: a site where waste is buried
words.example: The contractor diverts construction debris from the landfill.

words.meaning: a useful supply or source of material
words.example: The project uses fewer natural resources than the old process.

words.meaning: the natural home of a plant or animal
words.example: The expansion plan protects the wetland habitat near the site.

lessons.title: Daily Activities
lessons.description: Practical verbs and nouns for routines, errands, schedules, and everyday work.
lessons.tip: In listening questions, note time expressions and the order in which daily tasks occur.

words.meaning: a usual sequence of regular activities
words.example: Her morning routine includes checking the delivery schedule.

words.meaning: a plan showing the times when activities or events will happen
words.example: I checked the bus timetable before leaving the office for the client visit.

words.meaning: planned for a particular time
words.example: The scheduled maintenance will begin after business hours.

words.meaning: the activity of buying food and household supplies from a grocery store
words.vietnameseMeaning: vi?c mua th?c ph?m v? ?? d?ng t?p h?a
words.example: Linh does the grocery shopping on Wednesday evenings after work.

words.meaning: the act of traveling regularly between home and work
words.example: Commuting by bus gives her time to answer routine messages.

words.meaning: to make something ready for use or an event
words.example: Mina prepares the meeting room before the clients arrive.

words.meaning: the act of getting ready for something
words.example: Careful preparation kept the morning briefing on time.

words.meaning: to arrange things in an orderly way
words.example: I organize the invoices by date before filing them.

words.meaning: the act of arranging something systematically
words.example: The organization of the supply cabinet saves time.

words.meaning: to decide which tasks are most important
words.example: Please prioritize the customer requests due today.

words.meaning: something that is more important than other things
words.example: Resolving the billing error is our top priority.

words.meaning: a short trip to complete a task
words.example: She ran an errand at the post office during lunch.

words.meaning: a system for organizing days, weeks, and scheduled events
words.example: I added the client visit to the shared calendar.

words.meaning: a message that helps someone remember something
words.example: Set a reminder to submit the travel receipt tomorrow.

words.meaning: to cause someone to remember something
words.example: Please remind the team to lock the side entrance.

words.meaning: to plan or organize something
words.example: Could you arrange a taxi for the visiting consultant?

words.meaning: a plan or organization made in advance
words.example: The travel arrangement includes a shuttle from the station.

words.meaning: to go and get or gather something
words.example: Please collect your access badge from reception.

words.meaning: a group of items gathered together
words.example: A collection of signed forms is waiting in the mailroom.

words.meaning: to take something to a person or place
words.example: The courier delivers office supplies every Tuesday.

words.meaning: a small routine task needed to keep a home clean or organized
words.example: Taking out the recycling is the household chore assigned to Sam this week.

words.meaning: to collect a person or item from a place
words.example: I can pick up the printed contracts on my way upstairs.

words.meaning: to leave a person or item at a place
words.example: Please drop off the keys with the evening receptionist.

words.meaning: to remove dirt or make a place tidy
words.example: Staff clean shared desks at the end of each shift.

words.meaning: the act of removing dirt or keeping a place tidy
words.example: The cleaning of the conference room is booked for six.

words.meaning: to fix something that is damaged or not working
words.example: Facilities will repair the broken cabinet handle today.

words.meaning: clothes and other items that need to be washed, or the activity of washing them
words.vietnameseMeaning: qu?n ?o c?n gi?t; vi?c gi?t gi?
words.example: He puts a load of laundry in before preparing dinner.

words.meaning: to stop working or moving in order to relax
words.example: Take a short rest after finishing the inventory count.

words.meaning: an occasion when food is eaten
words.example: Employees can order a hot meal from the cafeteria app.

words.meaning: food remaining after a meal
words.example: Store the leftover lunch in the labeled refrigerator container.

lessons.title: Common TOEIC Expressions
lessons.description: Useful phrases and expressions heard in workplace notices, requests, and conversations.
lessons.tip: Identify the purpose of each expression: a request, a suggestion, a deadline, or a follow-up.

words.meaning: at the earliest time that is practical
words.example: Please send the revised quotation as soon as possible.

words.meaning: before a particular time or event
words.example: Reserve a visitor badge in advance to avoid delays.

words.meaning: as a representative of someone
words.example: I am contacting you on behalf of the regional manager.

words.meaning: responsible for managing or controlling something
words.example: Nora is in charge of the conference registration desk.

words.meaning: as stated or reported by a source
words.example: According to the notice, the east entrance will remain closed.

words.meaning: because of; caused by
words.example: The shipment was delayed due to severe weather.

words.meaning: as a replacement for something
words.example: Use the side entrance instead of the main lobby doors.

words.meaning: without being affected by something
words.example: The workshop is open to all staff regardless of department.

words.meaning: before a particular time or event
words.example: Please review the contract prior to the client meeting.

words.meaning: by a stated time at the latest
words.example: Submit the expense form no later than Friday.

words.meaning: to feel pleased about a future event
words.example: We look forward to welcoming you to the new office.

words.meaning: to be free or ready for use
words.example: A conference room will be available after 2 p.m.

words.meaning: to have a duty to manage or complete something
words.example: The assistant is responsible for booking meeting rooms.

words.meaning: to have an obligation to do something
words.example: All visitors are required to sign in at reception.

words.meaning: to be planned to happen at a particular time
words.example: The inspection is scheduled to begin at nine o'clock.

words.meaning: to check or ensure that something happens
words.example: Make sure the report includes the latest sales figures.

words.meaning: to discover information
words.example: I will find out whether the larger room is available.

words.meaning: to complete a form by writing information
words.example: Please fill out the supplier information form online.

words.meaning: to give completed work or a document to someone
words.example: Hand in your security pass before leaving the building.

words.meaning: to arrange or prepare equipment or an activity
words.example: The IT team will set up the laptops before the seminar.

words.meaning: to perform or complete a task
words.example: The auditors will carry out a review of the travel expenses.

words.meaning: to take further action after an earlier contact
words.example: I will follow up with the vendor about the missing parts.

words.meaning: to draw attention to a fact or detail
words.example: The supervisor pointed out an error in the monthly summary.

words.meaning: to have no more of something available
words.example: We have run out of visitor maps at the front desk.

words.meaning: to postpone something
words.example: They put off the product demonstration until next week.

words.meaning: to think of or produce an idea or plan
words.example: The design team came up with a more compact display.

words.meaning: to continue communicating with someone
words.example: Please keep in touch while you are working at the branch.

words.meaning: at a time that suits you
words.example: You may review the draft at your convenience.

words.meaning: provided so that you can consult it
words.example: I have attached the updated price list for your reference.

words.meaning: during the period before something else happens
words.example: The replacement printer will arrive Friday; in the meantime, use the one by reception.
